parameters.formDescription: Please complete this short form to begin onboarding with our practice.

parameters.jsCode:
// Draft engagement letter placeholder content (structure follows common
// ICAEW / ACCA engagement letter guidance - review with a qualified letter
// template / compliance team before sending in practice)
const row = $input.first().json;

const engagementLetterDraft = `ENGAGEMENT LETTER (DRAFT)

` +
  `Client: ${row.clientName}
` +
  `Business Type: ${row.businessType}
` +
  `Date: ${row.onboardedDate}

` +
  `1. Scope of Services
` +
  `   We will provide the following services: ${row.servicesRequired || '[to be confirmed with client]'}.

` +
  `2. Responsibilities
` +
  `   You are responsible for the accuracy and completeness of information and records provided to us, and for meeting your statutory filing obligations to HMRC and (where applicable) Companies House.

` +
  `3. Our Responsibilities
` +
  `   We will carry out the agreed services with reasonable skill and care, in accordance with the professional standards of [ICAEW / ACCA] and applicable law.

` +
  `4. Fees
` +
  `   Fees will be agreed separately and invoiced in accordance with our standard terms.

` +
  `5. Limitation of Liability
` +
  `   [Insert firm's standard liability clause.]

` +
  `6. Data Protection
` +
  `   We will handle your personal data in accordance with UK GDPR and our privacy notice.

` +
  `This letter is a draft template only. It must be reviewed and finalised by a qualified member of the practice before issue, in line with current ICAEW/ACCA engagement letter guidance.`;

return [{ json: { ...row, engagementLetterDraft } }];

parameters.subject: =Welcome to {{ $env.FIRM_NAME }} – Next Steps
parameters.text:
=Hi {{ $json.clientName }},

Thank you for choosing {{ $env.FIRM_NAME }}. We're looking forward to working with you.

To get you set up, please could you send us the following as soon as possible:

{{ $json.amlChecklist.map(i => '  - ' + i).join('\n') }}

We'll also send over an engagement letter shortly for you to review and sign - this sets out the services we'll provide and each party's responsibilities.

One more thing: to allow us to deal with HMRC on your behalf, we'll need you to authorise us as your agent. We'll send a form 64-8 (or a digital authorisation link) separately - please complete this promptly as it can take HMRC a few weeks to process.

If you have any questions in the meantime, just reply to this email.

Kind regards,
{{ $env.FIRM_NAME }}

parameters.subject: =Reminder: HMRC agent authorisation (form 64-8) – {{ $json.clientName }}
parameters.text:
=Hi {{ $json.clientName }},

Just a quick follow-up - if you haven't already, please could you complete the HMRC agent authorisation (form 64-8, or the digital authorisation link we sent) so we can act on your behalf with HMRC?

This is an important step as it lets us file returns and correspond with HMRC directly for you - without it, we may not be able to progress your work. HMRC processing can also take a few weeks, so the sooner this is submitted, the better.

Let us know if you need it resent or have any trouble completing it.

Kind regards,
{{ $env.FIRM_NAME }}
